author: Rochameg
content: I have been using the Wave app for several years, particularly here in Senegal. It offers excellent features that make our financial transactions much easier. However, there is one area that needs improvement: the transaction cancellation feature. Recently, I made a purchase using a friend's account. The vendor processed a Wave transfer to give us our change, but as soon as our backs were turned, he cancelled the transaction and the money disappeared. This is definitely a feature that needs to be revisited, Wave.
title: Transaction cancellation feature needs review

author: DevLadySow
content:
I use Wave regularly and really enjoy the app. However, there’s one feature that would make it even better: transaction statistics with date filters.

I’d love to be able to filter transactions by a specific period (for example, view all transactions from December) and see a summary of the totals:

* Total money in: cash deposits, account top-ups, received transfers, etc.
* Total money out: sent transfers, payments, purchases, etc.

This would make it much easier to track spending and manage personal finances.
title: Feature : Transaction Statistics & Date Filters
